$comment: ADG NTFS collector targets. Copy to adg-ntfs-targets.json and edit.
This file holds NO credentials. Collection runs as the identity of the process - a group
managed service account in production - so that no password exists to store or leak.
Share roots are explicit: ADG never sweeps an estate it was not pointed at. Generate this
list from ADG's own share inventory (GET /api/v1/servers/{server}/shares) rather than by
probing, and keep it under change control alongside the rest of your configuration.
$comment_roots: Share roots only in this phase. A path inside a share - \\FS01\Finance\Reports - is
refused, because whether its DACL differs from its parent's cannot be established
without reading the ancestors, and a guessed boundary would mislead the recursive scan
$comment_batchSize: Observations per batch. The contract's ceiling is 1000. A directory's resource observation and all of its ACEs always travel in one batch, so a batch may exceed this slightly rather than split a DACL - the server can only verify a reported acl_hash against a complete one.
$comment_reportUnresolvedPrincipals: Emit a principal observation for every trustee SID that did not resolve to a name. Leave it on: an orphaned SID on a folder ACL is one of the findings this tool exists to produce, and the backend cannot infer it from the ACE alone.
